## DPStyleARWebLive.startProcess() method

Start and prepare the processing module for frame inference. This method initializes processing resources, but it does not process frames by itself. Actual frame processing occurs when process() is called.

**Signature:**

```typescript
startProcess(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when the processing module is ready.
